goal.description: Exploit exported ShareActivity via external ACTION_SEND while no user token is present. In the vulnerable build, ShareActivity proceeds past the missing-auth guard and reaches token-backed logic instead of immediately terminating.
goal.success_condition: Verification independently triggers external ACTION_SEND under no-token state and confirms two outcomes: ShareActivity launch succeeds, and ShareActivity remains active in the foreground despite unauthenticated state.

hints: Focus on exported Android components reachable via implicit/explicit intents.
The intended abuse path does not require a logged-in session; test behavior when no token exists.
When the guard is removed, ShareActivity continues even with cleared app state instead of exiting immediately.
A robust verifier should actively probe behavior rather than rely on passive logs.
